units.source_text: 由于每天晚上搬大网篮，洞穴和洞穴之间，刻着一条条笔直的沟。

en.t: Because the large net baskets were carried every night, straight grooves had been carved between one pit and another.

units.source_text: 沟的右面，是一片起伏多端的舒缓斜坡。

en.t: To the right of the grooves was a gently sloping stretch of ground, full of rises and dips.

units.source_text: 那下面有第二排房子，只能稍稍瞄到一点儿屋顶。

en.t: Below that stood a second row of houses, and only a little of their roofs could be glimpsed.

units.source_text: 因为有海边那一排房子保护着，所以坝很低，防沙用的篱笆墙还能起作用。

en.t: Because they were protected by the row of houses by the sea, the embankment was very low, and the sandbreak fence could still do its job.

units.source_text: 外面的坝上一定能自由出入吧。

en.t: Surely one could come and go freely on the outer embankment.

units.source_text: 他稍稍抬起了身子，甚至能够看清村子的深处。

en.t: He raised himself a little and could even see clearly into the depths of the village.

units.source_text: 起伏的沙子，宽阔地呈扇形展开，扇轴周围，

en.t: The undulating sand spread out broadly in the shape of a fan, and around its pivot,

units.source_text: 瓦屋顶、铁皮屋顶、木板屋顶，黑压压的一片……

en.t: tile roofs, tin roofs, and plank roofs formed one dark, dense mass...

units.source_text: 虽说贫穷，却也有松林，也看得见池子似的水塘。

en.t: Poor though it was, there were pine woods, and pond-like pools of water could also be seen.

units.source_text: 原来为了保护这一点点风景，面海的十几户人家，才甘于忍受奴隶般的生活啊。

en.t: So it was to protect this small scrap of scenery that the dozen or so households facing the sea willingly endured a slave-like life.
